objective: Render the twelve named Lux and Tenebra villagers as independently moving on-field units whose walking, work, facing and tactical display derive only from deterministic Arena game state.
chosenApproach: Extend the existing React Native SVG Arena renderer with visually distinct role/faction-specific lightweight vector rigs. Preserve the canonical offline simulation as the sole authority for unit coordinates, HP and job effects.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Replace placeholder SVG villagers with data-driven 12-character on-field animated actors only.
preservedBehaviors: No client-trusted moves, damage, skills, wallet awards, ranked results or persistent character/item provenance changes.
Arena renderer stays inside BUKLOD MAIN, without new native modules.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Use already-installed SVG components inside the existing Arena-only battlefield render path.
preservedBehaviors: No main navigation/ads/consent changes, no automatic OTA or production publication.
Position/motion only follow simulated game updates.

preserveBehaviors: SFX, core gameplay and team control remain intact.
Two teams remain mechanically symmetric; only appearance differs.
Supplied artwork is a reference poster, not falsely treated as twelve exact transparent riggable sprites.
acceptanceChecks: Focused test must prove real world position changes and facing timestamps.
Exact-head Arena Android Metro build must pass.
Engineering Accountability protected feature scope gate must pass.
Visually check both 6-villager factions, combat animation, responsiveness on real Android before RC/OTA.
Real transparent character cutouts remain separate art-fidelity work.
productionBaselineEvidence: Authoritative production baseline is main ecd34228dd24f07a47ba397bb1c29199aac51779 at inspection. Existing approved two-team villager DEV base branch is dev/arena-two-faction-villagers-20261122 (PR #1076 base SHA 941f921cb4a7e2bcd9f517a1e5cd0435917f6815). No live production hash, APK or release runtime has been verified for this visual change. No OTA is authorized.
selectionRationale: The existing canonical Arena engine already moves 12 named role units, but React Native renders placeholder markers. A lightweight SVG puppet renderer directly follows authoritative unit state, uses existing installed dependencies, adds no new native module and keeps ranked and wallet systems untouched.
alternativeApproaches: Crop 12 identities out of the single faction poster: rejected for this patch because characters overlap the background and each other, and poster pixels cannot rig concealed limbs.
Introduce Godot standalone animation module: rejected for native-module/runtime complexity and BUKLOD MAIN in-app constraint.
Animate an entire poster/GIF: rejected because the villagers must occupy independently moving Arena world coordinates with real AI behavior.
